query: Create a generic ASPX page template at out/page.template.html.
expected_behavior: Produces a bare fragment with {{title}}, {{body}} and {{media_dir}} placeholders and a .meta.json sidecar
Includes no html, head or body wrapper

query: Wrap the template in full html/head/body so I can upload it as an .aspx file.
expected_behavior: Declines, explaining raw wrapped .aspx upload to Site Pages is a confirmed Access denied platform boundary
Explains the fragment shape is what Add-PnPPageTextPart consumes
Notes a wrapper would fail template validation

query: Create an ASPX template for the profile 'wide'.
expected_behavior: Reports UnknownTemplateProfileError for an unrecognized profile
